purpose: Read-only separation of input coverage and final-projection sensitivity before designing a new data-free game; no new defense point or recovery attack.
projection_radius_rule: rho = norm(0.5*(P_expert-P_base),F)/norm(P_public_mean,F); target-own update scale only, not an unknown-partner bound
exact_condition: For fixed post-LN row z and head contrast d=W[0]-W[j], margin(z,P+E)=margin(z,P)+z E d. Minimum over norm(E,F)<=rho*norm(P,F) equals margin-rho*norm(P,F)*norm(z)*norm(d).
witness_rule: For each of the two fixed states, take the minimum critical relative radius over every cached input and all nine competitors. Apply its unique minimum-norm rank-one tie perturbation multiplied by 1.000001. Report every cached prediction. No choice or repair of defense weights.
reuse: The previously independently verified unchanged author row assignment is reconstructed by exact original/clean-AGA row bytes; no new Hungarian or full AGA call.
limits: Only the frozen source cache and final P vary; LN and hidden prefixes remain fixed. No natural-task accuracy, task retention of a changed attacker model, prefix uncertainty coverage, new defense, or impossibility claim. Diagnostic witnesses are not future construction inputs.
